title: The Redirection for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 3.2.16 does not verify ownership of the email address…
description: The Redirection for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin versions before 3.2.16 does not verify ownership of email addresses submitted via its data request form action. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to create verified personal data erasure or export requests for email addresses they do not control.
